title: The Orbital Regatta's Sabotage
logline: A working-class rigging mechanic assisting an independent solar-sail racer discovers that a corporate yacht syndicate is using covert microwave lasers to shred rival sails during high-speed orbital regatta passes.

roles.description: Chief rigger for a family-owned solar racer; passionate, observant, and determined to see fair competition.
Master of the dominant corporate racing syndicate; arrogant, hyper-competitive, and heavily leveraged by luxury gambling cartels.
Chief race judge for the planetary yacht club; punctilious, proud of tradition, and susceptible to wealthy pressure.
A swift armed race tender used by the corporate syndicate to enforce perimeter lanes.
A glittering orbital marina where luxury racing yachts berth before planetary ring passes.
A high-speed turn marker situated in the perilous gravity tides of a ringed gas giant.
The association of small-budget privateer pilots and mechanics competing against corporate teams.

public_situation: Spectator yachts crowd orbital marinas as the planetary solar-sail championship approaches its decisive high-gravity turn around {role:high_gravity_course_buoy}.
private_truth: The corporate yacht's hull conceals a covert microwave emitter tuned to heat-stress the polymer sails of independent competitors until they tear during maximum acceleration.

beats.public_change: Fanfare flares over station holos as race officials announce record prize pools for the upcoming ring pass.

missions.reason: She pays an outside pilot to collect a replacement carbon-weave sail spar from a cargo depot before the qualifying heat closes.
missions.private_fact: Her pilot's qualifying sail shredded along clean thermal burn lines that could only be caused by directed electromagnetic beams.

beats.public_change: A second independent racer suffers catastrophic sail blowout during trials, tumbling out of the course lane.

missions.reason: She hires the pilot to scan the course buoy's optical telemetry array to catch the invisible microwave pulses fired during the corporate yacht's pass.
missions.private_fact: The commodore has mortgaged three orbital racing docks to fund his gambling syndicate, and losing would ruin him.

beats.public_change: {role:regatta_chief_marshal} announces that protests will not be accepted without physical emitter hardware submitted before the final heat.

missions.reason: She pays the pilot to destroy a corporate telemetry drone trailing the syndicate yacht and recover the discarded laser focusing lens dumped into the ring field.
missions.private_fact: Her younger sister is piloting the independent family yacht in the final heat and faces fatal decompression if targeted at high speed.

beats.public_change: {role:syndicate_security_skiff} maneuvers across the marina approach, attempting to ram the mechanic's transport before she reaches the judges' box.

missions.reason: She pays the pilot to disable the corporate security skiff before it runs down her shuttle outside {role:orbital_regatta_slipway}.
missions.private_fact: The syndicate commodore hails mid-combat offering a luxury yacht charter share and a hundred thousand credits if the pilot destroys the optical lens.

player_choice.prompt: With the security skiff disabled and the sabotage hardware verified, the pilot must decide whether to deliver the lens to the chief marshal to disqualify the syndicate, force a lucrative prize split, or accept the commodore's private bribe.

options.label: Deliver the emitter lens to the chief marshal on the grandstand to disqualify the syndicate yacht and award victory to the independent team
Confront the commodore privately to force an equal split of the regatta purse without public scandal
Surrender the focusing lens to the commodore to pocket the massive luxury charter buyout

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the lens to the chief marshal.
resolutions.summary: The corporate yacht is disqualified before millions of spectators. {role:independent_sail_mechanic}'s family wins the championship, while {role:syndicate_yacht_commodore} is stripped of his license.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot proved a corporate racing syndicate used covert lasers to burn rival sails during an orbital regatta.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot forces the commodore into a prize-sharing settlement.
resolutions.summary: The corporate team shares the purse under a quiet co-sponsorship deal. {role:independent_sail_mechanic} secures funding for her shop, while the commodore avoids public ruin.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot forced a wealthy racing syndicate to quietly divide its championship prize with working mechanics.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the commodore's bribe or destroys the lens.
resolutions.summary: The independent yacht's sail tears during the final turn, crashing into ring dust. {role:syndicate_yacht_commodore} claims the cup, rewarding the pilot with luxury credits.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot took a bribe to bury evidence of laser sabotage during a high-stakes planetary yacht race.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot never intervenes or abandons the defense.
resolutions.summary: The laser strike cuts both sails during the gravity pass. The independent yacht is dragged down into the gas giant's crushing atmosphere, ending the race in tragedy.

loose_threads.detail: The yacht club dockmaster registry shows an unlisted hazardous microwave emitter waiver signed under a luxury yacht charter company's tax shield.
A private casino syndicate in the orbital marina booked massive short positions against the independent privateer yacht six hours before the trials.

radio_hooks: Spectator armadas gather along gas giant rings for the annual solar-sail regatta.
Independent privateer teams lodge protests over unmonitored electronic racing corridors.
Yacht syndicate commodore boasts of guaranteed victory in championship finals.

voice_direction.independent_sail_mechanic: Energetic, fast-talking, and speaks with fierce blue-collar pride. Uses technical sailcloth terms effortlessly under stress.
voice_direction.syndicate_yacht_commodore: Effortlessly smooth, condescending, and speaks in aristocratic sporting jargon. Regards working mechanics with supreme indifference.
voice_direction.regatta_chief_marshal: Stiff, pompous, and obsessed with procedural precedents. Frantically tries to avoid offending wealthy marina patrons.
